author: GameSpot
description:
Tune into the Developer_Direct on Thursday, January 22 at 10am PT / 1pm ET / 6pm GMT to kick off 2026 with a look at some of the incredible games. Including exclusive gameplay and developer insights for Fable and Forza Horizon 6, as well our first in-depth look at Beast of Reincarnation.

Playground Games welcomes players back to the fairytale land of Albion, with an in-depth look at the Fable. Developers from the Playground team will unveil the magic and mischief that awaits players in this fresh new beginning for the franchise, including a first look at some new gameplay. Of course, the core themes of Fable will all be there – choice, consequence, drama, action, British humor and (of course) chickens, all reimagined for existing fans and new players alike.

title: Developer Direct 2026 Livestream (Fable, Forza Horizon 6, Beast of Reincarnation Gameplay)

author: GameSpot
description:
Here is a look at all of the new gameplay for Resident Evil Requiem shown during the latest showcase event held by Capcom before the game's release. 

A new era of survival horror arrives with Resident Evil Requiem, the latest and most immersive entry yet in the iconic Resident Evil series. Experience terrifying survival horror with FBI analyst Grace Ashcroft, and dive into pulse-pounding action with legendary agent Leon S. Kennedy. Both of their journeys and unique gameplay styles intertwine into a heart-stopping, emotional experience that will chill you to your core.

A new era of survival horror begins when Resident Evil Requiem launches February 27, 2026 for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, Steam, and the Epic Games Store.

description:
A compilation of Mine' combat gameplay, a look at Survival Hell, and story cutscenes.

Mine and Kanda are best buds on a romp through Kamurocho, fighting suspicious men in dark alleys, going wild in photo booths at Sega's arcade, and climbing their way up the Yakuza ladder. 

In this Yakuza 3 Kiwami 3 and Dark Ties compilation are several fights showing off the gameplay mechanics, including those introduced in Like a Dragon Gaiden: The Man Who Erased His Name, such as the wall jump kick attacks. You'll see Mine go into Beast Mode. You'll watch Mine show off his genius tattoos. And you'll experience Mine meeting Chairman Daigo for the first time.
